contentEn:
What Is the BC 2-5-10 Home Warranty?

BC's Home Protection Act (RSBC 1998, c. 160) mandates warranty coverage on every new home built and every substantial renovation in the province. The warranty follows the 2-5-10 structure: 2 years for labour and materials, 5 years for the building envelope, and 10 years for structural defects. Reno Stars construction is covered under the 2-year labour and materials provision, and we add a 3-year workmanship warranty on top of the statutory minimum.

What Each Warranty Year Covers

YearCoverageExamples
Year 1Labour + materials, 100%Tiles lift, faucet leaks, paint peels, door misalignment
Year 2Labour + materials, 100%Plumbing fixtures, electrical issues, HVAC defects
Year 3 (Reno Stars)Workmanship warranty — our additionCracks from settling, trim gaps, sealant failures we caused
Years 3–5Building envelope (floors, walls, roof)Water penetration, insulation failure
Years 1–10Structural defectsFoundation cracks, load-bearing wall failures

What Is NOT Covered

  • Normal wear and tear — scratched floors, worn grout from use
  • Damage caused by homeowner negligence or lack of maintenance
  • Upgrades or changes made by the homeowner after handover
  • Natural disasters — flooding, earthquakes, fire (covered by home insurance)
  • Cosmetic settling cracks in drywall (minor cracks under 3 mm are normal)

How to File a Warranty Claim in BC

If something goes wrong within your warranty period, BC homeowners have a clear path:

  1. Contact your contractor in writing — email is best, so you have a timestamp. Describe the issue with photos.
  2. Contractor responds within 30 days — most legitimate contractors resolve issues directly.
  3. If the contractor is unreachable or refuses, file with BC Housing's Home Protection Office: bchousing.org or 1-800-407-7754.
  4. For structural defects in years 1–10, contact the Home Protection Office directly regardless of contractor response.

Important: document everything with photos and dated communications from day one. This makes any claim straightforward to process.

What Makes Reno Stars' Warranty Different?

Reno Stars provides a 3-year workmanship warranty in addition to the BC statutory 2-year minimum. Our warranty covers:

  • Cracks in tile or grout caused by our installation work
  • Door and window operation issues from our fitting
  • Water damage caused by our trades' installation errors
  • sealant and caulking failures we applied

We carry $5 million in Commercial General Liability (CGL) insurance and active WorkSafeBC coverage on every project. Every Reno Stars project comes with a written contract that itemises the warranty scope and dispute resolution process before you sign.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation in Metro Vancouver? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars and receive the warranty document before work begins.

How Long Does a Reno Stars Renovation Take?

Renovation timelines in BC vary by scope. Here are typical durations based on our project data:

Project TypeTypical DurationNotes
Bathroom (standard)3–5 weeksDemolition to handover
Bathroom (full gut)6–8 weeksWith plumbing relocation
Kitchen6–10 weeksCabinetry adds 2–3 weeks
Whole house12–24 weeksVaries by size and scope
Basement suite14–20 weeksPermits required — adds 4–6 weeks

Frequently Asked Questions About BC Renovation Warranty

Does BC require contractors to be licensed for warranty to apply?

Yes. BC requires all residential renovation contractors to hold a Residential Builder Registration with BC Housing. An unlicensed contractor performing residential work voids the Home Protection Act warranty — always verify your contractor's registration at bchousing.org/licensing before signing.

Is the 2-5-10 warranty automatic on all renovations?

It applies to any residential renovation valued over $12,000 that requires a building permit. Cosmetic-only work under $12,000 without a permit may not qualify — confirm with your contractor and local building authority.

What does Reno Stars' 3-year warranty not cover?

Our 3-year workmanship warranty does not cover: damage from improper homeowner maintenance, natural settling beyond normal parameters, modifications made by others after our work, or pre-existing conditions we documented in the pre-project assessment.

Can I extend my warranty coverage?

Some third-party warranty programs offer extended coverage. BC Housing's Home Protection Office can provide referrals to approved extended warranty providers.

How do I verify a contractor's warranty and insurance before hiring?

Ask for a certificate of insurance naming you as additionally insured, verify their WorkSafeBC account in good standing, and check BC Housing's licensing registry. Reno Stars provides all three documents upfront before any contract is signed.
contentZh:
什麼是卑詩省2-5-10房屋保固？

卑詩省《房屋保護法》（Home Protection Act）規定，每個新房及大型裝修工程必須提供保固。保固結構為2-5-10：2年材料和人工，5年建築外殼，10年結構缺陷。 Reno Stars的工程涵蓋2年法定材料和人工保固，並在法定最低標準之上另提供3年工藝保固。

各保固年期的保障範圍

年期保障範圍實例
第1年人工及材料，100%瓷磚脫落、水龍頭漏水、油漆剝落、門框錯位
第2年人工及材料，100%水管裝置、電路問題、暖通缺陷
第3年（Reno Stars）工藝保固——我們的額外保障我們施工造成的裂縫、飾線縫隙、密封膠失效
第3至5年建築外殼（地板、牆壁、屋頂）滲水、隔熱失效
第1至10年結構缺陷地基裂縫、承重牆故障

哪些情況不在保障範圍內

  • 正常磨損——刮傷的地板、因使用而磨損的瓷磚填縫
  • 因業主疏忽或缺乏保養而造成的損壞
  • 工程移交後由業主進行的升級或改動
  • 自然災害——洪水、地震、火災（由房屋保險涵蓋）
  • 輕微石膏板裂縫（3毫米以內的細裂縫屬正常現象）

如何在卑詩省申請保固索賠

若在保固期內出現問題，卑詩省業主可按以下步驟維權：

  1. 以書面方式聯繫承包商——電郵最佳（方便留存時間戳記），附上問題照片。
  2. 承包商需在30天內回覆——正規承包商通常直接解決問題。
  3. 若承包商無法聯繫或拒絕處理，可向卑詩房屋局（BC Housing）房屋保障辦公室投訴：bchousing.org 或致電 1-800-407-7754。
  4. 第1至10年的結構缺陷，可直接聯繫房屋保障辦公室，無需先聯繫承包商。

重要提示：從第一天起就保存照片和帶日期的溝通記錄。這樣可使任何索賠過程更加順暢。

Reno Stars的保固有什麼不同？

Reno Stars在卑詩省法定2年最低保固基礎上，另提供3年工藝保固。我們的保固涵蓋：

  • 我們安裝工作造成的瓷磚或填縫裂縫
  • 我們安裝造成的門窗操作問題
  • 我們工匠的安裝錯誤造成的渗水損壞
  • 我們施工的密封膠和填縫失效

每個工程均持有500萬加元商業一般責任險（CGL）及有效的WorkSafeBC保障。每個Reno Stars工程均提供書面合同，在簽約前列明保固範圍和爭議解決程序。

想在溫哥華都會區規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯繫Reno Stars獲取免費、無約束力的報價，工程開始前先收到保固文件。

Reno Stars裝修工程需要多長時間？

卑詩省裝修時間因工程規模而異。以下是我們項目數據顯示的典型工期：

工程類型典型工期備註
浴室（標準）3至5週從拆除到移交
浴室（全面翻新）6至8週涉及水管改動
廚房6至10週訂製櫥櫃增加2至3週
全屋12至24週因規模而異
地下室 suite14至20週需要許可證——另加4至6週

關於卑詩省裝修保固的常見問題

卑詩省是否要求承包商持有牌照才能享受保固？

是的。卑詩省要求所有住宅裝修承包商持有卑詩房屋局的住宅建築商登記。無牌照承包商進行的住宅工程將使《房屋保護法》保固失效——在簽約前務必在 bchousing.org/licensing 驗證承包商的登記狀態。

2-5-10保固是否自動適用於所有裝修工程？

適用於任何價值超過12,000加元且需要建築許可證的住宅裝修。低於12,000加元且無需許可證的純裝飾工程可能不符合資格——請與承包商和當地建築主管部門確認。

Reno Stars的3年保固有什麼不在保障範圍內？

我們的3年工藝保固不涵蓋：因業主保養不當造成的損壞、超過正常範圍的自然沉降、我們完成工程後由他人進行的改動，或我們在工程前評估中記錄的既有問題。

我可以延長保固期限嗎？

部分第三方保固計劃提供延期保障。卑詩房屋局房屋保障辦公室可轉介認可的延期保固提供商。

僱用前如何驗證承包商的保固和保險？

要求提供將您列為附加被保人的保險證書、驗證其WorkSafeBC帳戶狀態良好，並在卑詩房屋局許可證登記處核查。Reno Stars在任何合同簽署前主動提供這三份文件。
